visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and khaki pants, stands in front of wooden shelves filled with various women's shoes and handbags. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail showroom. He gestures naturally while looking directly at the camera with a calm expression. (2) A quick cut shows a dimly lit storage warehouse with metal racks stacked with cardboard boxes. A large white cartoon question mark overlay appears in the center. The scene is cluttered, conveying a sense of overwhelming inventory. (3) The man appears in a wood-paneled room with rows of rustic leather boots on shelves. The lighting is warmer and more atmospheric. He points toward the camera and uses expansive hand movements to emphasize his speech. (4) A high-tech 3D printing machine is shown in a close-up shot. A white shoe with a complex, hollow lattice structure is being printed layer by layer. The background is dark, focusing attention on the white printing material and the mechanical arm. (5) The man holds a completed white lattice shoe in a dark studio setting. He rotates it to show the intricate design. The video transitions into a montage showing him wearing the shoes in different settings: walking on a sidewalk with a bus passing, standing in a white hallway, and kicking his legs to demonstrate lightness. (6) Close-up shots show the white shoe resting on a grey surface, highlighting the porous, skeletal design and the 'D6' branding on the sole.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Problem Explanation -> Innovation Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> Social Proof -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the 'D6' brand's 3D-printed shoes. It starts by identifying a common pain point for shoe retailers—excessive inventory—and presents on-demand 3D printing as the technological solution. It then highlights product benefits such as comfort, breathability, and versatile style to encourage viewers to click the purchase link.
